response.justification: Bogdan has extensive technical experience with 15+ years in software engineering, including roles in AI-agent infrastructure and cloud-native development. However, his focus has been more on software craftsmanship and less on AI strategy or cloud/AI product leadership at scale. His entrepreneurial background (GISCollective) and open-source contributions are strong positives, but his lack of explicit AI/ML expertise or recognized AI products/platforms slightly lowers his fit for this AI Strategy-focused role.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse engineering experience across full-stack, cloud, and embedded systems
Strong open-source contributions and entrepreneurial experience (GISCollective founder)
Proven ability to deliver high-performance systems (low-latency apps, real-time metadata handling)
concerns: Limited direct experience in AI strategy or cloud/AI product leadership roles
No advanced degree (Master's/PhD) in AI-related fields
No clear demonstration of recognized AI expertise or built AI products/platforms

key_factors.factor: Cloud/AI leadership and strategic product development
Diverse engineering experience and open-source contributions
